title: How to make spell vfx with ai? How do you do it?
author: ugur51
selftext: I think Anyone who tried, understands me. Doing pose-to-pose or 2x2,4x4 etc spritesheet doesnot work. Every frame is like from another source.

comments.author: Southern-Nerve7577
comments.body:
The workaround I found was to use Google Flow (Gemini) to create an 8-second animated video, then send it to your AI model (Claude or ChatGPT) and have it extract frames to build a spritesheet. The resulting video is below. hopefully that helps

replies.author: Every-Prize4720
replies.body:
tldr. emitter spawns particles and particles have their own behavior. Particle system allows you to adjust spawn rate. Particles themself have position, velocity and lifespan thus during upfate phase each particles updates their position with velocity \* delta.

Define effect. Spawn said effect. Emitter spawns particles, particles fly around, you get nice effect.
